deviation_sentence: E1 (e1_smooth_pooled) did not pass the pre-registered promotion rule: gate G6 failed on its class-shuffle control (2 of 23 class permutations >= the fitted adapter, p = 0.125 > 0.05). Under the rule as written the final pair stays {03, 05}. The captain selects E1 instead of 05 as the second final file as a documented deviation from that rule, reviewed by the independent auditor. 03 remains selected in every case. The failed control concerns only whether the class-specific adapter values matter - they are not established; a uniform expansion of about 7-10 % performs the same - not leakage, reproducibility or the direction of the effect. E1 is not claimed to be proven better than 03: the local gain is +0.011 mean-of-day AP on 198 labelled rows of two days (paired frame bootstrap P ~ 0.997, not adjusted for the 35 variants examined; the adjusted bar 0.9986 is not reached). Its behaviour under the box convention of the test annotators is unknown.
